steps.name: verify-db-backed-blog-after-design-refresh
steps.summary: Verified populated Blog discovery/search/detail with isolated local PostgreSQL and fake-provider fixtures. Fixed long unbroken titles clipping list/search layouts after a failing browser check. Nine layout checks at 1440/390/320px, desktop/mobile navigation and keyboard interaction, private/missing HTML+Markdown 404, search/crawler boundaries, 13 integration tests, unit/lint/typecheck/build passed. No OCI or real provider calls were made.
